title: [master] Variant Code mandatory should not allow to refresh the production order with no variant code
summary: The Refresh Production Order report now validates that when an item requires a variant code, the production order cannot be refreshed without specifying one.
key_points: Added CheckVariantCodeMandatory validation to the report
Prevents refreshing production orders when variant code is mandatory but not provided
Introduced OnBeforeCheckVariantCodeMandatory publisher event for extensibility
Test coverage added for the new validation logic
Fixes issue where mandatory variant requirement was being bypassed
quote: Variant Code mandatory should not allow to refresh the production order with no variant code
